test_title: PYST 22 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: In the sentence: "Some deep-sea creatures, like certain jellyfish, glow in the dark through a chemical reaction in their bodies," is the sentence in **active or passive voice**?

options.text: Active voice - “ the subject performs the action
Passive voice - the action is done to the subject
Passive voice - the agent is unknown
Active voice - no verb is used

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Active Voice**, the subject of the sentence performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• In this sentence, the subject is "**Some deep-sea creatures**" (specifically, certain jellyfish). The action they are performing is "**glow**."
 
• Because the subjects themselves are performing the action of glowing, rather than having the action performed upon them, the sentence is in the active voice.
 
• The word count for the provided passage is **155 words**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Voice Analysis:** *"Some deep-sea creatures (Subject) + glow (Action/Verb) + in the dark..."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 & 3: Passive Voice** – These are incorrect because the sentence does not use a "to be" verb + past participle (e.g., "Light is produced by..."). In passive voice, the subject receives the action.
 
• **Option 4: Active voice - no verb** – This is a contradiction. Every sentence must have a verb, and in this case, "glow" is the active verb.
